headline: World Bank: proposal to extend Youth, Technology and Jobs project by 18 months
summary: The World Bank is nearing approval of a government-proposed amendment to the $200 million Youth, Technology and Jobs project. It would extend implementation by 18 months.
why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that funds development projects. Its loan amendments affect public spending and project timelines in recipient countries.
